title: Kevin O'Leary Says 'I Don't Care If It's A Gift For Your Birthday'—Take 10% Of Any Money That Comes Your Way And Invest It To Get Rich
summary: Kevin O'Leary isn't interested in your excuses—especially the ones wrapped in a bow. In a 2020 interview with CNBC, the "Shark Tank" investor didn't just suggest setting money aside. He issued a directive. "I don't care if it's a gift for your birthday present," O'Leary said. "You have to take 10% of your paycheck every two weeks and invest it."
